code:
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths-ignore: ["**.md"]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
caption: Skip doc-only changes; react only to the pull_request events that matter.

eyebrow: On a timer, or on demand
code:
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * 1-5"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        required: true
        default: "staging"
caption: Cron runs weekday mornings; workflow_dispatch adds a manual Run button.
